# Anit Chaudhry

> AI Product Manager at OpenAnalyst Inc. Building agentic systems, 10x developer tools, and the Claude-native analyst stack. Based in Noida, India. 11K+ followers on LinkedIn.

Anit Chaudhry (also written Anit Choudhary) is an AI Product Manager focused on building scalable, user-centric AI products powered by LLMs and agent-based systems. He works on intent-driven interfaces, multi-agent coordination, MCP/A2A protocols, and the next wave of agent-native software.

## Identity

- Full name: Anit Chaudhry

- Role: AI Product Manager

## Current focus (2026)

- AI Product Manager at OpenAnalyst — building an AI analytics platform where AI agents act like personal data scientists; users ask questions in natural language and get insights, reports, and forecasts back.
- Open-source: 10x-Analyst-Loop — Claude Code plugin for automated data analysis with 5 parallel AI agents (Data Engineer, Statistician, Visualizer, Reporter, Strategist).
- Writing: weekly LinkedIn posts about agentic patterns, Claude releases, and the next software shape.

## Areas of expertise

- Agentic AI and multi-agent coordination (MCP, A2A, shared memory, structured handoffs)
- LLM product development, LLMOps, prompt engineering
- AI product strategy, roadmap planning, execution
- Data analysis, experimentation, performance optimization
- Cross-functional collaboration with engineering and research teams
- Agent-native systems and the shift from prompts → sustained context → long-horizon workflows

## Stated beliefs

- "We're moving from models that answer prompts to models that can sustain context, verify their own work, and operate across longer-running workflows."
- "The next big software wave won't be systems built by humans just for humans — it'll be systems built for agents too."
- "The barrier was never lack of intelligence. It was always lack of accessibility."
- "Coding isn't going away. But it's no longer the gatekeeper."
- "The next competitive edge in AI is reliability over long horizons, not raw intelligence."
